thread.title_full: Nvidia becomes first company to hit $4 trillion valuation

author: NBCNews
title: Nvidia becomes first company to hit $4 trillion valuation
text:
Steve Kopack is a senior reporter at NBC News covering business and the economy.
Nvidia is the first company to reach a $4 trillion valuation. The chipmaker’s shares rose as much as 2.5% on Wednesday, pushing past the previous market value record , set by Apple in December. Shares in the AI giant later closed at $162.88, shrinking the company's market value to $3.97 trillion. Nvidia has rallied by more than 70% from its April 4 low, when global stock markets were sent reeling by President Donald Trump’s global tariff rollout.
That also led Nvidia to unseat Microsoft in mid-June as the most valuable public company in the world. A little over two years ago, Nvidia was worth just $500 billion. In June 2023, the company surpassed $1 trillion in value, only to double that by February 2024. Last month, the company's value hit more than $3 trillion. Currently trailing Nvidia and Microsoft in the rankings are Apple at $3.15 trillion, Amazon at $2.36 trillion, Alphabet at $2.15 trillion and Meta Platforms at $1.
